title: Postdoctoral Fellowships at Massachusetts Institute of Technology
field: Natural and technical sciences, biomedicine, biotechnology (interdisciplinary)

compensation.value: Up to approximately DKK 1.2 million per year, maximum DKK 3.6 million per fellowship
compensation.evidence_quote: approximately up to DKK 1.2 million per year, with a maximum of DKK 3.6 million per fellowship

about: Novo Nordisk Foundation postdoctoral fellowship: two years at MIT, then a final return year at a Danish host institution. Interdisciplinary projects in natural and technical sciences, biomedicine or biotechnology with potential impact on human health or sustainability. Earliest start 1 October 2027.
requirements: PhD within 5 years of the fellowship start date (PhD students may apply if graduating before the start)
Danish host institution employing the fellow for the whole grant period

upskill.name: Academy course catalog
why: No course objective covers the stated requirements ("PhD within 5 years of the fellowship start date", "Host principal investigator at MIT", "Danish host institution employing the fellow for the whole grant period"): they are eligibility conditions, not skills. The shortlist only matched on generic terms ("natural", "technical"), so the post links to the Academy catalog, not a specific course.
